name: Portal
tagline: Surround your work or downtime with filmed natural landscapes and immersive soundscapes.
description:
Portal brings filmed natural environments and spatial soundscapes to the Mac. Each location combines landscape footage with layered environmental audio, creating a background for focused work, relaxation, or a short break from a noisy room.

## Features

- Explore immersive portals recorded in forests, coastlines, mountains, and other natural settings.
- Listen through headphones or speakers, with spatial-audio support on compatible hardware.
- Use focus and relaxation modes to shape a work session or wind-down routine.
- Turn supported scenes into a desktop backdrop or screen-based ambient environment.
- Download selected content for access when a connection is unavailable.
- Continue with the same Portal membership across supported Apple devices.

## Where it fits

Portal is for people who find nature audio more helpful than music or silence while working. The visual component also makes it suitable for an idle second display. It is an ambience tool, not a clinical treatment for stress, sleep, or attention problems.

## Privacy and requirements

Portal for Mac requires macOS 13 or later. Streaming and downloading environments uses network access and local storage. Account, purchase, and analytics handling follow Portal's and Apple's current privacy disclosures; downloaded material remains subject to the service's access rules.

## Pricing

Portal is free with limited access. Paid access costs $3.49/month, $34.99/year, or $99.99 as a lifetime purchase. The annual option includes a seven-day trial.
